title: Build Human Pressure Signal Index v0.1
objective: Convert the expanded AI/neurodiverse recurring research signal plan into Supabase schema, ingestion jobs, dashboard/API layer, and weekly research brief outputs.
anchor_thesis: We measure when human systems go out of balance — and predict failure before it shows up in incidents, claims, or collapse.

source_document.name: National Wastewater Drug Monitoring Program - Report 25.pdf
observed_facts: ACIC NWDMP Report 25 covers around 57% of the Australian population in August 2025.
The program monitors 12 licit and illicit substances including nicotine, alcohol, cannabis, methylamphetamine, amphetamine, cocaine, MDMA, MDA, heroin, oxycodone, fentanyl and ketamine.
Program sampling continues every 2 months for capital city sites and every 4 months for regional sites, while public reporting moved to one annual report in 2025.
The report explicitly states wastewater data is most valuable when combined with other data and intelligence to build a comprehensive picture.

A_high_frequency: weather BOM and global heat/flood/fire data
B_structured_au: PBS prescription data including ADHD stimulants SSRIs anxiolytics sleep medication
D_neurodiverse_cognition: academic journals and clinical trial registries

schema_requirements_sql_outline: create schema if not exists research;
create table if not exists research.signal_sources (...);
create table if not exists research.signal_observations (...);
create table if not exists research.signal_release_calendar (...);
create table if not exists research.pressure_index_scores (...);
create table if not exists research.pressure_alerts (...);
create table if not exists research.research_briefs (...);
alter table ... enable row level security;
create unique index if not exists ... on idempotency_key;
acceptance_criteria: Payload is accepted by the Pen runner or visible in the GitHub inbox path.
At least 10 recurring research sources are registered with expected frequency and next release date where available.
At least one synthetic dry-run pressure score is generated and labelled PRETEND, not REAL.
audit.log entry or equivalent evidence object is created if bridge/Supabase access is available.
rollback: Archive or supersede this inbox job with a new idempotency key; do not delete. Schema migrations must be additive/idempotent unless separately gated.
